messages:
julie: Pushed a prototype for the SLO Threshold composer + inline preview. Mainly: unit selector next to value, rolling window picker, and a channel-level preview. Can folks skim for copy and accessibility? screenshot attached :camera_with_flash:
tom: Quick skim  copy nit: header label currently says "Threshold" which feels vague. Suggest "Alert threshold" with subtext "trigger when > value over window".
adrian: Functionality note: percent input accepts >100 in current build. Need validation and clear helper text (min/max/step).
chen: On the preview I noticed toggling a suppression rule sometimes removes channels entirely instead of showing suppressed state. That made me think the rule removed the route.
a11y-bot: Automated check: percentage input should use role="spinbutton" with aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" and aria-valuenow. Also window picker lacks descriptive label for screen readers.
julie: Good catches. Plan: enforce min=0 max=100 step=0.1 for %; add aria labels for the window selector. Also add aria-live="polite" for preview updates.
tom: Visual contrast: the medium severity yellow fails contrast against the white card on normal monitor calibration. Recommend darker fill or stronger border.
adrian: UX question: should the unit dropdown show shorthand like "/5m" or verbose "per 5 minutes"? Shorthand saves space but may confuse new users.
chen: Prefer verbose in the control, shorthand in compact mode. Also show example in helper: "5 errors per 5m = ~1% error rate on 8k reqs".
a11y-bot: Suggestion: the "what does this mean?" tooltip must be accessible: expose via aria-describedby and ensure content is added to DOM on focus (not only on hover).
julie: Agree. I'll implement accessible tooltip that appears on focus and hover and is referenceable by aria-describedby.
tom: Preview copy: product asked for explicit language "X channels will be notified" vs "X matches". I vote for channels. Also show a sample message snippet so users know what gets sent.
adrian: Also UX for suppressed channels: please don't hide them. Dim them and add a small badge "suppressed by <rule name>". Add a toggle "Show suppressed" to reveal details. Hiding creates false negatives in the preview.
chen: I'll change the preview logic to dim + add badge and include an aria-label like "Channel foo, suppressed by rule bar" for screen readers.
a11y-bot: When the preview updates, announce: "Preview updated: 4 channels will be notified, 2 channels suppressed." Keep it short. Ensure updates are rate-limited to avoid spam.
julie: Implementation checklist I'm taking: 1) enforce numeric validation & spinbutton aria on percent input, 2) reword header to "Alert threshold" + helper, 3) add rolling window display and helper example, 4) adjust severity color tokens for contrast, 5) accessible tooltip via aria-describedby, 6) preview updates via aria-live with concise announcements, 7) dim suppressed channels + badge + "Show suppressed" toggle, 8) include keyboard walkthrough GIF in PR.
tom: One more microcopy nudge: under the threshold control add small muted text: "This threshold is evaluated over the selected rolling window." Helps orient people.
adrian: Edge-case: when window=1m some metrics are noisy; maybe show a quick CTA "Use 5m for steady alerts" or a warning.
julie: Good idea. I'll add a subtle inline hint for windows < 5m recommending 5m for stability.
chen: Will implement suppression badge + focusable details. Also will ensure the preview rows are reachable via keyboard (tab) and have visible focus.
a11y-bot: Final check: ensure hit targets are >=44x44 CSS px for touch on mobile and provide alternative stacking layout for narrow screens (no horizontal controls).
julie: Thanks all. I'll push changes and attach a short GIF of keyboard navigation + preview changes. Tagging @tom @adrian for a 10m review when done :thumbsup:
